name: Block Stack
description: Falling blocks, built from real materials: the time is spelled in oak, walnut, brushed steel and copper blocks on a board-formed concrete wall, with a steel-framed well where a walnut piece keeps landing on a stack of metal, wood and concrete.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
